BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Agriculture and Natural Resources.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning payment for surveys of state-owned aquatic lands by current or prospective lessees of such lands.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to payment for surveys of state-owned aquatic lands by current or prospective lessees of such lands; and amending RCW 79.105.120.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 79.105.120 and 2005 c 155 s 108 are each amended to read as follows:Survey to determine areas subject to sale or lease.
BillSection.P: The department may cause any state-owned aquatic lands to be surveyed for the purpose of ascertaining and determining the area subject to sale or lease. The department may not require a current or prospective lessee of such lands to pay for the cost of such a survey.
